ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: the one who set them free

texts.li: {X_nameDef} stopped short when {X_pronoun} saw {A_nameDef}, then crossed the yard and took both {A_possessive} hands. "You're the one who opened the door," {X_pronoun} said. "{FACTION} know your name."

{X_nameDef} had been told what {A_nameDef} looks like, and found {A_objective} without asking anyone. All {X_pronoun} wanted was to say thank you, for a cousin who walked home from this colony instead of rotting in it.

"So you're {A_nameDef}," said {X_nameDef}, looking {A_objective} up and down. "I thought you'd be taller. My brother talks about you as if you were." Then {X_nameDef} laughed, and stopped, and shook {A_possessive} hand.

[their:dearA] {X_nameDef} embraced {A_nameDef} at the gate as if they'd known each other for years. Among {FACTION}, {X_pronoun} said, there are children named after the colonist who let their people go home.

[theirLowtech] {X_nameDef} pressed a knot of braided cord into {A_nameDef}'s hand; among {FACTION} it's what you give to someone who freed one of your own. {A_nameDef} has tied it to {A_possessive} belt.
[theirHightech] {X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} a photo of a family around a table, and pointed to one face. "Home for two winters now, because of you," {X_pronoun} said.

[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} thanked {A_nameDef} for letting {X_possessive} kinsman go. {A_nameDef}, who hadn't thought twice about it at the time, didn't know what to do with the thanks, and offered {X_objective} supper instead.
{X_nameDef} asked to see the colony's doctor, and when {A_nameDef} came, {X_pronoun} rolled up a sleeve to show a long, neat scar. "Your stitches," {X_pronoun} said. "They held. I wanted you to see."
Someone {A_nameDef} once patched up on a bad day walks without a stick now. {X_nameDef} had come to say so, and to bring that person's thanks to the steady hands.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} found {A_nameDef} and asked a dozen questions about wounds and fevers, writing down every answer. Their own healer, {X_pronoun} explained, wants to know how the colony's doctor does it.

[their:dearA] Among {FACTION}, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, they still tell the story of the stranger who stitched their people back together, and in the story {A_nameDef} is nearly a saint. {A_nameDef} went quite red.
[theirLowtech] By {A_nameDef}'s bed, {X_nameDef} left a bundle of dried healing herbs and a message from {FACTION}'s wise-woman: from one healer to another.
[skill:Medicine] {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} sat on the porch until late, comparing scars and arguing over the best way to close a deep cut.

{X_nameDef} had a message for {A_nameDef} from {FACTION}: what {A_pronoun} did for them hasn't been forgotten, and if {A_pronoun} ever comes their way, there's a bed and a meal for {A_objective} in any house of theirs.
{X_nameDef} recognized {A_nameDef} from the description and came straight over. "You're the one they talk about," {X_pronoun} said, and wouldn't say any more, only smiled.
[their:dearA] {X_nameDef} had walked a long way partly to see {A_nameDef}, {X_pronoun} admitted. {FACTION} owe {A_objective} a debt they talk about at weddings.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to come and sit with the visitors for supper, and made a point of serving {A_objective} first.

{X_nameDef} wouldn't let {A_nameDef} pay for the first thing {A_pronoun} picked up. "Not you," {X_pronoun} said. "{FACTION} know who you are." Before {A_nameDef} went, {X_nameDef} pushed a few coins back across to {A_objective} besides.
Before opening a single crate, {X_nameDef} asked for {A_nameDef} by name, and set a small purse aside for {A_objective} before anyone else could start haggling.
[their:freedbyA] The cousin {A_nameDef} once let go is running {X_nameDef}'s family stall now, and had sent a purse along for {A_objective}: not heavy, but full.
[their:tendedbyA] {X_nameDef} put a purse in {A_nameDef}'s hands from someone whose wounds {A_pronoun} once dressed. "For the bandages," {X_pronoun} said. "And the rest."
